description: Topic resolution and header mapping on transports that carry Benzene metadata natively (wire-contracts.md §2, transport-bindings.md §1.2-1.3). Every such transport exposes a string->string metadata channel under a different native name — SQS/SNS message attributes, Pub/Sub attributes, Service Bus/Event Hub application properties, Kafka/RabbitMQ headers — so the cases below are written against that neutral dictionary and each runner adapts them to its own native shape. This is the fixture that pins the metadata key names across ports: a port that renames or misspells one still passes every other fixture, because the envelope, status and HTTP mappings never touch native metadata.

topicSources.fallback: the AMQP routing key, so a non-Benzene producer still routes

topicSources.note: EventBridge has its own routing key, so this binding MUST NOT require a benzene-topic attribute.
Derived from the change event; there is no producer to set metadata.

metadataCases.name: topic-key-is-case-insensitive-on-read
metadataCases.note: wire-contracts.md preamble: header keys are case-insensitive on read and SHOULD be written lower-case.

metadataCases.name: an-unprefixed-topic-key-does-not-route
metadataCases.note: The regression case. 'topic' is the envelope's field name, not a metadata key: the envelope is Benzene's own namespace, native metadata is shared with the application and the transport. A port that accepts the unprefixed key here cannot exchange messages over a queue with a port that does not.

metadataCases.name: absent-topic-key-leaves-the-topic-unresolved
metadataCases.note: Unresolved, not an error: the router decides what an empty topic means (envelope-cases.json pins that as validation-error).

metadataCases.name: version-travels-alongside-the-topic
metadataCases.note: benzene-version is tier C — only ports that implement payload versioning run this case.
